      • onStateChanged

        void onStateChanged(ConnectState state,
                    java.lang.Object params)
        The BaseTransport instance associated with the BaseReader instance is called when the connection state of the Device changes.

        params - If the event is accompanied by additional information, a non-null value is passed to the instance.
